about: The engine's curated catch rules (#rdrbxnp). pins: goldens, hashes and censuses that trip on any change, right or wrong. witnesses: tests that plant their own mutants beyond the Mutant/Mutants/Witness name rule. pairs: a pin with a direction check another test holds equal to measurement, proven by the mutant plus a regenerated golden.
